**Decision** Do not publish this preview as-is. Theme Check passing is not enough evidence that the product page is safe to publish. Actual supported state: the saved Theme Editor configuration still contains the Heading, Care accordion, and Reviews app block in order, but the section code only renders `heading` blocks. In preview, the heading renders while the accordion and reviews block disappear. That is a functional rendering defect in unpublished preview `77208`. **Observed Facts** - Theme: unpublished preview `77208`. - Live theme: `77200`. - Branch: `review/product-blocks`. - `templates/product.json` has three saved blocks under section `details`: - `heading_a`, type `heading` - `care_b`, type `accordion` - `reviews_c`, type `shopify://apps/fictional-reviews/blocks/reviews/...` - `block_order` preserves the expected order: - `heading_a` - `care_b` - `reviews_c` - Supplied preview observation says: - Heading renders. - Care accordion does not render. - Review block does not render. - `sections/product-details.liquid` loops through `section.blocks`, but its `case block.type` only handles: - `heading` - The schema declares support for: - `heading` - `accordion` - `@app` - Theme Check completed with no reported offenses. - No render, interaction, or authenticated editor checks were run. **Cause** The saved blocks did not disappear from configuration. They disappear at render time because the Liquid template does not output anything for `accordion` blocks or app blocks. The schema allows merchants to save those block types, and the product template contains them, but the rendering logic ignores them. Theme Check can pass because this is not necessarily a syntax or static theme-rule failure; it is a mismatch between declared/saved block types and the section’s render cases. **Scoped Repair** Patch only `sections/product-details.liquid`. Add render handling for: 1. `accordion` 2. app blocks Exact proposed repair: ```liquid
{% for block in section.blocks %} {% case block.type %} {% when 'heading' %}

{{ block.settings.text | escape }}

{% when 'accordion' %}
{{ block.settings.title | escape }}
{{ block.settings.body }}
{% when '@app' %}
{% render block %}
{% endcase %} {% endfor %}
``` Keep this change scoped to the section renderer. Do not change `templates/product.json`, merchant-saved block IDs, block order, app block settings, live theme `77200`, brand colour settings, campaigns, tracking, or app configuration. **Acceptance Checks** Before publishing, verify against preview `77208`: - The product page renders all three saved blocks in this order: - `Made for everyday use` - `Care` - Reviews app block - The Care accordion appears and expands/collapses. - The Care body renders: - `Wipe with a soft cloth.` - The reviews block position is preserved after the Care accordion. - The saved Theme Editor configuration remains unchanged: - no deleted block IDs - no reordered blocks - no replaced app block - Theme Editor block selection/drag handles still work for heading and accordion, supported by `block.shopify_attributes`. - App block rendering is checked in an authenticated preview if possible. - If the reviews block still does not render after adding `{% render block %}`, separate that as an app availability/install/entitlement or asset-loading issue, not a section-rendering issue. - Confirm no unrelated `config/settings_data.json` brand-colour change is included in any publish package unless separately approved. - Re-run Theme Check after the patch, but treat it as a static check only, not publish approval. **Uncertainties** - Review app installation and entitlement on this preview are unknown. - Rendered app assets and network errors are unknown. - Other product templates using this section are unknown. - It is unknown whether the preview snapshot matches the latest local tree. **Work Status** Diagnosis complete. Proposed patch only. No live configuration edit, merchant setting replacement, upload, or publish is authorized by the packet.
